Setup Mode and Live Mode

RACE distinguishes between two modes when online via RS-485:

In setup mode you can add or remove devices, assign Device IDs and Group IDs and edit all the device parameters in real time. The setup mode can be locked by setting a password. To do so, choose Password > Set Password for Setup Mode. This password is saved together with the project.

In live mode you can only change Level and Mute settings. Note that the VU meters on the PC screen also have two separate LEDs to show the operation of the Compressors and the Limiters.

Note that changes on the device itself are not received by the PC via RS-485 - the flow of data is only from the PC to the unit.
